after.promptProse: Before the white marble throne, Saber Alter holds a bouquet of dark crimson roses in both hands. An opaque white gothic bridal gown and long lace veil replace the black evening dress, while her blonde hair remains in a neat braided bun beneath the veil. Her golden eyes glisten as a proud smile softens her reserved expression. High windows cast pale daylight across the gown’s folds and the stone floor. Frame the complete formal silhouette, bouquet and trailing veil together, keeping the moment ceremonial and nonsexual. No lettering.
